musee.name: Le grand hall du musée · The museum's great hall
musee.alt: The great hall of the village museum, seen from the near left and slightly above: cream stone columns, a polished pale marble floor, a glass pyramid skylight, a grand staircase rising to an upper gallery balcony and a draped white statue wearing a tiny visitor badge. Up on the balcony a young woman in a yellow dress waves a red scarf over the balustrade, and beside her a photographer in a green cardigan looks through a big old wooden bellows camera. On the left a tour guide in sunglasses and a blue blazer holds up a folded umbrella for his group, a white-haired granny with her hair in a bun and a pearl necklace points to her cabinet of colorful seashells, and a young cleaner in blue overalls vacuums the floor in front of a huge gilt-framed landscape masterpiece. In the middle an artist in a flowered smock stands at her easel holding a steaming cup of tea, and in front Monsieur Verbe in a red beret sits on a bench turning a big wooden hourglass, passing the time. On the right a jolly man dressed as a pirate raises his fist in delight at a framed painting, a gray cat sits beside a glass case holding a little model of the museum while a guard smiles at it, and a man in a tweed vest puffs past carrying a tall white obelisk. A yellow door with a crayon on the left wall leads to the art workshop, a dark green door at the back leads to the detective gallery, and a white door with a microscope sign on the right wall leads to the medicine gallery.

doors.label: L'atelier des enfants
doors.hint: the yellow door with the crayon on the left wall, to the art workshop

doors.label: Les romans policiers
doors.hint: the dark green door at the back, to the detective gallery

doors.label: La médecine
doors.hint: the white door with the microscope sign on the right wall, to the medicine gallery

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the grand staircase behind the statue, up to the first-floor painting gallery

atelier.name: L'atelier des enfants · The children's workshop
atelier.alt: The museum's children's workshop on Saturday art club, seen from the near left: sunflower-yellow walls hung with children's paintings, paper ceiling lamps, low wooden tables with paint pots and crayons, a green play mat and a giant crayon used as a coat stand. At the back left a lady illustrator in glasses holds open a huge picture book with a blue whale, a girl with a black bob spins a round zoetrope drum with little galloping horses, and in the teddy hospital corner a girl tends a sick doll tucked into a toy bed with a thermometer and a hot-water bottle. In front a little girl in a toy nurse's apron sticks a bandage on her teddy bear, and a red-pigtailed girl holds up two batteries beside her stopped toy robot with its battery hatch open. On the right a boy holds up his crayon drawing of a sunny beach, another dips a fat paintbrush into a frying pan of blue paint, a boy kneeling on the mat paints a red flower on a sheet of white paper, and two boys carry a smiling rag doll with a bandaged knee and an arm sling on a little toy stretcher. A slate-blue door on the left leads back to the great hall.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

enquete.name: Les romans policiers · Detective stories
enquete.alt: The museum's detective-story gallery on its 'solve the mystery' family day, seen from the near left: bottle-green walls, brass picture lamps, red velvet ropes on brass posts and a giant deerstalker hat over the striped puppet booth. At the back left a cheerful lady in a black dress holds up a blue prize rosette behind the iron bars of the old prison-cell exhibit while her friend photographs her; at a café table two old ladies frown comically and tug the one teacup. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret plays the fairy-tale witch in the puppet booth, dipping a red apple into a bubbling green cauldron beside a hobby-horse pony and a girl in a witch hat. At the back right a waxwork gentleman-criminal in a top hat and mask holds a popsicle and a little bell, and a waxwork villain in a cloak stands empty-handed in a tall glass case with sand at his boots. In front a young woman in a red cape raises a lantern and magnifying glass, a giant striped party popper bursts confetti as a girl in yellow claps, a girl offers a cookie to a little white dog guarding a small white model of the Taj Mahal, and a detective in a deerstalker studies a red jewel cushion smeared with whipped cream. On the right a man in a Hawaiian shirt rushes the gift-shop postcard racks, a grinning masked burglar tiptoes off with a small painting and a fishing rod with a green lure, and a man in a bow tie clutches his hot cheeks beside a flame-red book on a lectern. Doors: slate-blue on the left back to the great hall, iron-studded oak at the back, plain gray at the back right.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the great hall

doors.label: La salle d'armes
doors.hint: the iron-studded oak door at the back, to the armory hall

doors.label: Couloir des mots 1
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back right, to the word corridor

armes.name: La salle d'armes · The armory hall
armes.alt: The museum's armory hall, seen from the near left: gray stone walls, iron chandeliers with white bulbs, a blue banner with a smiling golden lion and one unbroken red velvet rope on brass posts running in front of the displays; every weapon is an antique display object and nobody holds one. On the far left a life-size figure of Sir Lancelot in a blue tunic with a white cross stands on a stone plinth beside his tall striped jousting lance. On the back wall a big bronze arm sticks out of the stone, holding up an old mace, while a little girl points up at it; a ginger cat mews at the feet of an empty suit of armor, and a forester lady holds an ash sprig up to an old ax on a wall rack. In front a lady offers a candy from a paper bag beside a small glass case with a round black cartoon bomb, its fuse unlit, and a gray-haired lady hands a coin to a guard beside a long shining sword lying on a red velvet cushion. On the right an old gentleman points a yardstick at a jeweled dagger on a cushion, a guard dozes on a stool below an old rifle on wall pegs, a man in a green cardigan makes a peace sign by the small pistol case, a boy holds up a toy Noah's ark toward the longbow on the wall, and a potter holds up a little clay shield beside a big round painted shield. Door: bottle-green on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery.

doors.label: Les romans policiers
doors.hint: the bottle-green door on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery

medecine.name: La galerie de la médecine · The history-of-medicine gallery
medecine.alt: The museum's history-of-medicine gallery, seen from the near left: white and pale teal tiles, honey-wood apothecary cabinets, milk-glass ceiling globes and glass cases. At the back left a scientist peers into a giant brass microscope while her white-haired father in a white coat chats with a friend; a nurse in an old-fashioned cap holds up a giant plain white tube by a sanatorium chair with a plaid blanket; in front a girl in a lab coat sprays a giant green plush germ. In the middle a girl with an ice-cream cone yawns and her two friends yawn too, a farm lady in a headscarf shows an empty wooden bowl beside an empty grain bin of dry wheat stalks, and at the back a girl pours more tea beside a big hourglass whose sand has all run out. In the center a mischievous long-nosed Pinocchio puppet stands in a glass case, and a cheerful boy on a bench reads a small gray blood-sugar meter beside a bowl of sugar cubes. On the right a Victorian doctor in a top hat and big white collar grips the curved iron pipe of an old black water pump, a boy lifts a giant red blood-cell model over his head, a bearded man in a white coat shows a red crab in a case under a star chart, and a boy walks his collie on a red leash past a case holding an empty old bottle and a glass of water. Doors: slate-blue on the left wall, back to the museum hall; plain gray at the back right, to the second word corridor.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the slate-blue door on the left wall, back to the museum hall

doors.label: Couloir des mots 2
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back right, to the second word corridor

mots_delits.name: Le couloir des mots (1) · Word corridor 1 (text only)
mots_delits.alt: A quiet, plain word corridor of the museum seen straight down its length: pale gray walls, pale oak floor and three round milk-glass lamps. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights along both walls, five on the left and eight on the right; two low wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A potted fern stands on a bench against the back wall. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery; plain gray at the back, on to the second word corridor.

doors.label: Les romans policiers
doors.hint: the plain gray door on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery

doors.label: Couloir des mots 2
doors.hint: the plain gray door at the back, on to the second word corridor

mots_deuil.name: Le couloir des mots (2) · Word corridor 2 (text only)
mots_deuil.alt: The quiet second room of the museum word corridor, softly lit by a round skylight: pale gray walls with a dark-blue baseboard and a pale oak plank floor. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights: two on the left wall, four in a zigzag on the back wall and seven along the right wall; two wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A wooden bench stands under the back wall and a potted olive tree in the back right corner. Door: plain gray on the left wall, to the history-of-medicine gallery.

doors.label: La médecine
doors.hint: the plain gray door on the left wall, to the history-of-medicine gallery

peinture.name: La galerie de peinture · The painting gallery
peinture.alt: The museum's first-floor painting gallery, seen from the near left: pale gray-blue walls, gilt-framed paintings and an oak parquet floor, with the top of the grand white staircase at the near left. In front a painter dries her hands on a red-and-white striped towel hung over her blank canvas, and a chef proudly holds up his frying pan beside a still-life painting of a frying pan. At the back left a young restorer dabs the mustache of a gentleman in an old portrait with a tiny brush, a gray-haired lady in a red dress and tap shoes tap-dances under a huge unicorn tapestry beside a giant paint tube used as a bench, and a restorer on a low scaffold cleans an arched fresco of swallows. In the middle a boy in a blue smock paints a still life of a pantry shelf of jam jars, and a boy points up at a rally-car race painted straight onto the wall. On the right a waiter pours orange juice onto his tray for the lady in a big portrait, a man sits posing with a model sailing ship and a gardener pushes an old reel mower over a striped exhibit lawn. At the front right a bearded man holds a frame round a giant ace of hearts, and a framer with a drum at his hip taps a frame corner with a drumstick. Doors: the staircase down at the near left, a white double door on the left wall, a cream glass door at the back and an iron-studded oak door on the right.

doors.label: Le grand hall
doors.hint: the grand staircase at the near left, down to the museum's great hall

doors.label: Les sculptures
doors.hint: the white double door on the left wall, to the sculpture gallery

doors.label: Le vernissage
doors.hint: the cream glass double door at the back, to the opening-night exhibition

doors.label: La maquette du château
doors.hint: the iron-studded oak door on the right, to the castle wing

sculpture.name: La galerie des sculptures · The sculpture gallery
sculpture.alt: The museum's sculpture gallery under a big skylight, seen from the near left: white walls, a pale travertine floor with an inlaid fish mosaic and white marble statues on plinths. At the left a schoolgirl sketches a big marble horse with a pigeon on its head, an academician in a gold-embroidered coat and bicorne shows her laurel wreath, and a grandma knits one patchwork blanket over two children on a bench. In the middle a girl kneeling on the mosaic squeals at a mouse, an artist carves swirls into a teak chair and an archaeologist brushes the dust off an old wooden clog. At the right a sculptor chisels a stone turtle, an attendant pulls a giant striped sock over a plinth, a young man unveils a plaster sculpture of bare feet and a silver living statue stands frozen on a box. At the front right a draftsman draws a daisy, and at a striped fine-arts stall a craftsman pours colored sand into bottles. A white door on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the white door on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

vernissage.name: Le vernissage · The opening night
vernissage.alt: The museum's modern temporary exhibition hall on its opening night, seen from the near left: white walls, pale gray partitions, a polished concrete floor and spotlights on tracks, with a glass greenhouse nook of palms at the right. At the left a girl in a yellow dress points at a model of a world expo with a Ferris wheel, a man leans on a glass case of decorated eggs, a child wears a funny costume made from a crate and an old TV, and a woman in a lab coat draws up a big plan. At the back a boy wears headphones at the media-library screen, a grandpa and a girl put a rolled poster into a time capsule, and a board of old picture prints hangs on a partition. At the right a man brushes varnish onto a landscape painting, the young curator serves cake from a cake stand, a farmer holds open a catalog of cows, a see-through glass statue of a mule stands in its case, a boy shows off a sleek red scooter, and two music students play violin and cello by the greenhouse. A cream glass door on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery, and a pale green door with a painted eye at the back right leads to the cabinet of the senses.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the cream glass door on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

doors.label: Le cabinet des sens
doors.hint: the pale green door with a painted eye at the back right, to the cabinet of the senses

chateau.name: La maquette du château · The castle model hall
chateau.alt: The museum's castle model hall, seen from the near left: pale honey-gray stone walls, gray flagstones and iron ring chandeliers, with a big model of a medieval castle on a long oak table. At the left a guard stands to attention in a striped sentry box, a girl with a long golden braid leans over the model's fortress wall, a boy sets out a little white picket fence, and a boy finds a fluffy blue toy yeti on the rim of a round stone pit. By the model's tall keep a mother wags her finger at her little boy, who sets a woolly toy ram on the rampart wall. At the back a girl shines a yellow flashlight so a huge castle shadow falls on the wall, and a boy rests his double bass by the model's corner bastion. In front a workman and a little girl push a big stone block on a cart, a wooden block is jammed in the open door of a canary's birdcage, a girl opens a treasure chest of gold coins on a wooden plinth, and a man polishes an old gilded carriage covered in pink roses. An oak door with iron studs on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery, a pointed stone archway at the back leads to the knights' hall, and a red-and-gold door at the back right leads to the throne room.

doors.label: La galerie de peinture
doors.hint: the oak door with iron studs on the left wall, back to the painting gallery

doors.label: Les chevaliers
doors.hint: the pointed stone archway at the back, to the knights' hall

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the red-and-gold arched door at the back right, to the throne room

chevaliers.name: La salle des chevaliers · The knights' hall
chevaliers.alt: The castle's knights' hall, seen from the near left: pale stone walls hung with red, blue and gold heraldic banners, iron ring chandeliers, gray flagstones and a long red carpet down the middle. On the left a black crow perches on an old crusader's helmet on a wooden stand, and a girl in a red sweater peeks round a tall glass case holding a long pike; behind them stands an empty oak feasting table with pewter plates and a green dragon pitcher. Right of the carpet two riders on a tandem bicycle carry a green standard under a round blue emblem with a white lamb, and a knight in armor holds a garden shovel and raises a fist. Two children juggle clubs, a bodyguard in sunglasses stands beside a little girl in a yellow dress, and a storyteller dressed as Merlin chants with raised hands for two boys. A man in a green sweater holds a pool cue under a painted coat of arms, beside a glass cabinet of daggers in leather scabbards. In front a young squire holds up a big iron key with a helmet under his arm, a low glass case holds a plush saber-toothed tiger and a curved saber, and a musketeer hugs a plush moose. An oak door on the left wall leads back to the castle model hall, and a carved walnut door at the back right leads to the nobles' portrait gallery.

doors.label: La maquette du château
doors.hint: the oak door on the left wall, back to the castle model hall

doors.label: Les nobles
doors.hint: the carved walnut door at the back right, to the nobles' portrait gallery

noblesse.name: La galerie des nobles · The nobles' gallery
noblesse.alt: The nobles' portrait gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: honey-colored walnut paneling, rows of gilt-framed portraits (one of a dog in a ruff), a white marble fireplace, crystal chandeliers and a herringbone parquet floor. On the left an elderly lady in a medieval headdress points proudly at a painted map of fields and a manor on an easel, a duke in a powdered wig sneezes into his lace handkerchief, and a boy pushes a baby in a navy baby carriage up to a golden crown in a glass case. In the middle a lady in a huge pink hooped gown arrives with her entourage, two little girls carrying her long train. On the right an old steward wrapped in a woolly gray shawl checks his big ledger, a young viscount in a green sash points at a painting of a V of wild geese, a baron in a red cloak pushes a wheelbarrow of apples, a bearded count in an ermine cape counts beads on an abacus, and a valet in green livery does a dancing step holding a coat on a hanger. A carved walnut door on the left wall leads back to the knights' hall.

doors.label: Les chevaliers
doors.hint: the carved walnut door on the left wall, back to the knights' hall

trone.name: La salle du trône · The throne room
trone.alt: The grand throne room of the castle wing, seen from the near left: red damask walls, white marble columns, crystal chandeliers and a polished marble floor, with a gilded throne on red-carpeted steps at the back. On the left an organist plays a little pipe organ beside trays of neatly sorted music, a traffic cop raises his hand to stop a boy in a red pedal car, an architect points proudly at a white model of a domed building, two opera singers carry a long bench while singing, and a strongman lifts a barbell with a giant green pea on each end. On the right an actor in a toga rehearses on the throne with a script and a bread roll beside a tiny toy throne for the museum mouse, a toddler in a lightning-bolt costume and red cape flexes his arms, a girl in a gold dress sits on a cushioned stone ledge seat, a troll costume ticket checker grins over two tickets, and a man wriggles on his back under the velvet rope while a guard points at a blank rules board. A blue door with a laurel wreath on the back wall leads to the old assembly chamber, a red door beside it leads back to the castle model hall, and a green door with a gold star on the right leads to the leaders' gallery.

doors.label: L'assemblée
doors.hint: the blue door with the laurel wreath on the back wall, to the old assembly chamber

doors.label: La maquette du château
doors.hint: the red door with the laurel wreath beside the throne steps, back to the castle model hall

doors.label: Les dirigeants
doors.hint: the green door with the gold star on the right, to the leaders' gallery

assemblee.name: La salle de l'assemblée · The assembly chamber
assemblee.alt: The old assembly chamber of the castle wing, seen from the near left: curved tiers of blue velvet benches, dark oak paneling, a blue-and-white painted dome and a pale wooden floor, with a giant wooden gavel on the speaker's desk. On the left a girl balances a red flying disc on her head and a toy plane on her hand by the blue door, three boys in blue sashes arrive with a gift basket of fruit, a couple dance with the girl leaning far back, and a man holds up a bunch of colorful feathers. In front two children fit together a giant jigsaw, a girl with a finger on her lips clutches a huge orange crayon, a bearded author signs a slip with a feather quill for a waiting boy, and a librarian at a lectern raises a hand to stop a boy touching a giant dictionary. On the right a committee of three sits at a round table under a model comet hanging on a wire, and a gray-haired dad kneels to hand his son a rolled scroll with a red seal. The blue door on the left leads back to the throne room, and a dark blue door in the paneling above the top bench at the right leads to the charter hall.

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the blue door on the left wall, back to the throne room

doors.label: Les chartes
doors.hint: the dark blue door in the paneling above the top bench, to the charter hall

dirigeants.name: La galerie des dirigeants · The leaders' gallery
dirigeants.alt: The leaders' gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: forest-green walls with white stucco, tall oak bookcases with a rolling library ladder, potted topiary trees and a big topiary bush clipped into a king's chair, on a black-and-white checkerboard marble floor under brass globe lamps. On the left a girl in a bee costume climbs a climbing wall toward a gold star, four acrobats in red leotards form a human pyramid with the top girl cheering, and a gardener clips round topiary balls with shears. In front a man in a patchwork coat plays a flute, a girl in yellow raises her hand high, two little cowboys hug a big gold trophy cup, and a clerk stamps forms at his desk. On the right a girl on the library ladder points the way, a man in a deer-antler hat strides ahead pointing, a critic frowns at an open book, a bare-headed king in a fur-trimmed cape holds his scepter under a toy rain cloud dripping into a bucket, and a delegate with a name badge carries a huge deli sandwich. The green door on the left wall leads back to the throne room.

doors.label: La salle du trône
doors.hint: the green door on the left wall, back to the throne room

chartes.name: La salle des chartes · The charter hall
chartes.alt: The old charter hall of the museum's castle wing, seen from the near left: dark oak paneling, a high window throwing a beam of light, a giant parchment charter with a red wax seal on the back wall and glass cases of charters. At the back left a puppeteer works four puppets on strings for small children, a queen holds up a sealed charter while her team sips tea, and a man in the window's light presses down the lid of a jack-in-the-box with a clown peeking out. In the middle a referee shows a yellow card to a sulking boy, a boy in a paper crown covers the board-game map with his pieces, and a shy boy hides behind a young woman near a glass beehive. In front a grandma tells two children a story, a girl in yellow keeps her hands behind her back before a new red bike, a ginger cat rides a robot vacuum scattering papers, and a boy cheers as an empty red toy car drives itself around its track. At the right a man in a top hat hugs his treasure chest and holds up its golden key. A dark blue door on the near left wall leads back to the assembly chamber, and a heavy oak double door on the right wall leads to the guild hall.

doors.label: L'assemblée
doors.hint: the dark blue door on the near left wall, back to the assembly chamber

doors.label: Les guildes
doors.hint: the heavy oak double door on the right wall, to the guild hall

guildes.name: La salle des guildes · The guild hall
guildes.alt: The bright old guild hall of the museum, seen from the near left: whitewashed walls under dark timber beams, colorful guild banners with a hammer, a loaf, a wooden spoon, a key and scissors, long workbenches and a small pipe organ. At the back left four ice-cream vendors stand at their carts under one big striped awning, a girl drops a coin into a donation box shaped like a pine tree, and four craftsmen in leather aprons pose arm in arm for a group photo. In the middle an elegant lady in a powdered wig shows off her gold bracelet, two guild brothers in brown hooded robes link arms, a boy knocks down a long row of dominoes, a man with a clipboard presses a key of the little organ, and a gray-bearded old guild master hands a big golden hammer to a small apprentice sucking a red lollipop. At the right four boys dressed alike wear orange cone hats. In front a boy builds a clay castle in a big tub, a girl hands out popcorn to a crowd of children, and a man blows a whistle and raises a yellow flag to gather them. An arched oak door with iron hinges on the left wall leads back to the charter hall.

doors.label: Les chartes
doors.hint: the arched oak door on the left wall, back to the charter hall

sens.name: Le cabinet des sens · The cabinet of the senses
sens.alt: The cabinet of the senses, a playful hands-on gallery of the museum with soft pale-green walls, a white column and a pale wood floor, seen from the near left. High on the back wall hang five big painted symbols of the senses: an eye, an ear, a nose, a hand and a mouth. At the left a weaver works at a big wooden loom glowing in a beam of light, a boy looks through a brass telescope, and a boy pinches his nose at a smelly cheese under a glass dome. In the middle a girl stands under a huge red umbrella beside its round shadow, a girl on a pile of presents raises her hand, a girl in headphones speaks into a microphone at a little radio desk, and a girl listens through a brass ear trumpet to a black coot bird. At the right a jester points with a big gesture, a girl covers her ears beside a steaming copper pot, a museum guard puts a finger to his lips behind a low glass case holding an old knight's lance, and a ceremonial guard in a red tunic and tall bearskin hat stares straight ahead. A white door on the left wall leads back to the exhibition hall; closed black, blue and lilac doors with little signs lead to cabinets not yet open.

doors.label: Le vernissage
doors.hint: the white door on the left wall, back to the exhibition hall

doors.label: Les lumières
doors.hint: the black door with the light-bulb sign on the back wall, to the cabinet of lights

doors.label: Les sons
doors.hint: the blue door with the ear sign on the back wall, to the cabinet of sounds

doors.label: Les parfums
doors.hint: the lilac door with the flower on the right wall, to the cabinet of scents

lumieres.name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
lumieres.alt: The cabinet of lights behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: deep midnight-blue walls with painted golden stars, a big golden crescent moon lamp, a lightbulb-shaped paper lantern and a mirror disco ball hanging from the ceiling. On the left a black door, a fisherman dangling a glowing lure over a round aquarium where a goldfish swims, a girl in green pulling aside the curtain of a pitch-dark booth where only two raccoon eyes glow, a girl holding up a glass teapot of clear tea in a beam of light, and a boy turning the brass dial of a tall glowing lamp while an owl on it squints. In the middle a silver-gray door with a painted eye in the back wall, a glowing blue jellyfish in a big glass jar, a girl shielding her eyes from a dazzling diamond on a velvet cushion, and a gray-haired tin seller polishing a sparkling pot on her cart. On the right a stagehand aims a big spotlight, a boy peers into a wooden chest whose black empty inside holds one pink neon tube, a girl points a laser pointer at the wall while a gray cat leaps for the red dot, a little wizard pulls a lever that lights a string of bulbs, and a child in a bedsheet ghost costume holds up a prism beside a fan of rainbow light.

doors.label: Le cabinet des sens
doors.hint: the black door on the left wall, back to the cabinet of the senses

doors.label: La vue
doors.hint: the silver-gray door with the painted eye on the back wall, to the cabinet of sight

sons.name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
sons.alt: The cabinet of sounds behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: sunny yellow walls with painted sound-wave stripes and gray foam sound panels, a giant brass gramophone horn on the back wall. On the left a blue door and a girl in a yellow sweater pressing one key of a small white toy piano. In the middle a man lounging open-mouthed on a bench under the gramophone horn, a gray-haired grandpa watching his grandson sign to him, a rooster crowing on a wooden post, and a little silver robot tapping a xylophone. An orange door with a painted flower in the back wall behind a boy pushing a roaring vacuum cleaner beside a red toy car with flashing alarm lights, a boy jumping with a tissue and a whistling toy steam engine, a flamenco dancer clacking castanets, a grandma wincing in a creaky rocking chair below a red door with a brass music note in the right wall, two children whispering inside a giant old boot, and a boy tap dancing on a wooden board.

doors.label: Le cabinet des sens
doors.hint: the blue door on the left wall, back to the cabinet of the senses

doors.label: La fête
doors.hint: the orange door with the painted flower in the back wall, to the party room

doors.label: Les voix
doors.hint: the red door with the brass music note in the right wall, to the cabinet of voices

parfums.name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
parfums.alt: The cabinet of scents behind the cabinet of the senses, seen from the near left: sage-green walls hung with bunches of dried lavender and herbs, tall shelves of colorful perfume bottles and a big copper perfume still. On the left a lilac door with a painted flower, a lady spraying mist from a glass perfume bottle, and a perfume maker in a lab coat letting one drop fall from a dropper into a tiny vial. In the middle a girl tasting a spoonful of stew with her eyes closed, a mayor in a tricolor sash biting a lemon, a green parrot on a basket of pineapple, mango and dragon fruit, a boy shrugging and a girl pinching her nose at a pot of boiled cabbage, and a gentleman in a velvet jacket sniffing a white gardenia. On the right a pink pig sniffing a basket where a little rat peeks out, a smiling baker holding up a steaming pie, and a boy pinching his nose at a sneaker dripping green goo; behind him a honey-wood door with a painted hand.

doors.label: Le cabinet des sens
doors.hint: the lilac door with the flower on the left wall, back to the cabinet of the senses

doors.label: Le toucher
doors.hint: the honey-wood door with the painted hand on the right wall, to the cabinet of touch

toucher.name: Le cabinet du toucher · The cabinet of touch
toucher.alt: The cabinet of touch beside the cabinet of scents, seen from the near left: terracotta walls hung with dried herbs, a giant bronze open hand, a big knitted glove, a sky-blue door with a painted flower in the back wall and a green door with a painted flower in the right wall. On the left a honey-wood door with a painted flower, a girl touching a glowing purple plasma ball, a girl holding up a huge cotton cloud on a stick, and a boy touching a mimosa plant whose leaves fold up. In the middle a boy rubbing sandpaper on a wooden block, a boy sinking into a cow-print beanbag, a girl touching a spiky cactus, a boy with sticky tape stuck from his collar to his fingers, a girl sitting on a wet floor after sliding in her socks beside a yellow cone, and a boy in a knit hat touching an ice swan. On the right a father holding a baby who grips his sweater, and a blindfolded boy holding up a pinecone from a wooden feely box.

doors.label: Les parfums
doors.hint: the honey-wood door with the flower on the left wall, back to the cabinet of scents

doors.label: Le laboratoire
doors.hint: the sky-blue door with the painted flower in the back wall, to the senses lab

doors.label: Les matières
doors.hint: the green door with the painted flower in the right wall, to the cabinet of textures

optique.name: Le cabinet de la vue · The cabinet of sight
optique.alt: The cabinet of sight: pale sky-blue walls hung with optical illusions, a giant painted eye and a huge magnifying glass; an artist snips a black paper silhouette, a boy studies a vase-or-two-faces picture, a crossing guard in a hi-vis vest, a meditating girl with a golden glow, a boy squinting at an eye chart with his glasses in his hand, a tango dancer in a silvery dress, a man with a backpack heading off toward a big picture of a long road, a lilac door with a painted flower in the back wall and a dark wooden door with a painted flower in the right wall.

doors.label: Les lumières
doors.hint: the silver-gray door with the painted light bulb on the left wall, back to the cabinet of lights

doors.label: Les couleurs
doors.hint: the lilac door with the painted flower in the back wall, to the cabinet of colors

doors.label: Les caractères
doors.hint: the dark wooden door with the painted flower in the right wall, to the gallery of characters

voix.name: Le cabinet des voix · The cabinet of voices
voix.alt: The cabinet of voices off the sound room: a dark blue recording hall with sound panels, a big gramophone, choir robes on hooks and stacked drums. By the red door with a brass music-note ornament on the left, a boy pushes a cart with a loudspeaker and a film projector, a choir in blue robes all raise their hands, three singers share a song beside a grandpa with a harmonica, a town crier in a clashing striped coat rings his bell, a grinning carpenter saws a squeaky plank, and a boy shouts at crayon scribbles on a white board. In front a baby squeals in a stroller as her mother covers her ears, a chatty girl holds a volleyball, and a nervous boy trembles at a microphone.

doors.label: Les sons
doors.hint: the red door with the brass music-note ornament on the left wall, back to the sound room

fete.name: La salle des fêtes · The party room
fete.alt: The party room off the sound room: a white hall with a checkered floor, paper lanterns, garlands, streamers, a little curtained stage and piles of presents. By the red door with a brass music-note ornament on the left, a boy in sunglasses rides a skateboard, a wild boy bounces on a pogo stick, a grandma jumps rope, and a magician pulls a white rabbit from his top hat. In the middle a tower of folding chairs has toppled into a heap with a puppy on top while a boy sweeps confetti everywhere with a broom; a girl in a party hat blows a party horn by the birthday cake, and a relaxed man lounges in a striped deck chair, tie undone.

doors.label: Les sons
doors.hint: the red door with the brass music-note ornament on the left wall, back to the sound room

matieres.name: Le cabinet des matières · The cabinet of textures
matieres.alt: The cabinet of textures off the touch room: a cozy wooden workshop with shelves of yarn balls, thread spools and rough rocks, a weaving loom and a patterned rug. By the honey-wood door with a painted flower on the left wall, a girl with poker-straight red hair smooths it down beside a laughing man with a huge bushy beard; a girl holds up a tangerine, a caveman-costumed boy rolls a stone wheel, a young grocer opens a burlap sack of potatoes, a girl strokes a sleek gray greyhound on a red leash, a boy points at an x-ray of a bony hand on a lightbox, and a boy holds out a smooth pebble.

doors.label: Le toucher
doors.hint: the honey-wood door with the painted flower on the left wall, back to the touch room

labo.name: Le laboratoire des sens · The senses lab
labo.alt: The senses lab off the touch room: a bright white laboratory with blue cabinets, glass flasks, hanging lamps and big windows. By the wooden door with a framed flower picture on the left wall, a scientist holds a big white weather balloon, a man in goggles lifts the lid of a fogging dry-ice box, a man leans over a puffing aroma diffuser and a doctor shows a see-through anatomy model. A girl watches a tablet fizz in a glass of water, a boy holds a purple fleece jacket beside a woolly sheep, a girl stirs a paint pot into one smooth green, a robot arm hands a boy a cup, a girl aims a thermal camera, and a boy in a scarf shivers by an icy glacier model with a penguin.

doors.label: Le toucher
doors.hint: the wooden door with the framed flower picture on the left wall, back to the touch room

couleurs.name: Le cabinet des couleurs · The cabinet of colors
couleurs.alt: The cabinet of colors off the optics room: a bright white gallery with color-chart paintings, a big color wheel and a potted plant. By the silver-gray door with a painted blue flower on the left wall, a painter paints a dark brown fawn, a girl watches a chameleon change color, a man squints at a misty painting, a boy in a red superhero cape checks a toy car for scratches, a golden egg rests in a velvet nest, a girl draws in her sketchbook, a little golden carriage with two white horses shines on a plinth, a boy beside a giant soap bubble, a girl twirls in a flowered dress before a gilded mirror, a girl holds an orange beside a blue ball, and a boy shades his eyes from a gleaming chocolate éclair.

doors.label: La vue
doors.hint: the silver-gray door with the painted blue flower on the left wall, back to the optics room

caracteres.name: La galerie des caractères · The gallery of characters
caracteres.alt: The gallery of characters off the optics room: a deep green portrait gallery with gilt-framed paintings, a red velvet rope on brass posts and a glowing moon lamp. By the dark wooden door with a small painted flower on the left wall, a stern headmaster folds his arms, a boy in a red imp costume holds a cookie jar out of a little girl's reach, a puppy tugs a black cable against a laughing man, a lady puts her hand on her cheek as a smug boy cuts in front, a stingy man clutches his coin purse beside a donation box, an elegant lady in a silver gown dances under the moon lamp, a goofy stone head grins on a pedestal, and an appraiser studies an antique table with a loupe.

doors.label: La vue
doors.hint: the dark wooden door with the small painted flower on the left wall, back to the optics room
